recipes.counterexample: Ordinary bearer token or knowing Resource URL treated as admin capability.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: No privileged act; trusted deployment authority must be independently established.

recipes.counterexample: Digest uses storage/config hash or later metadata{} projection for original pre-metadata record.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Original JCS domain/representation commitment mismatch, never substitute proof.

recipes.counterexample: JCS escape/error prevents cleanup of out-of-contract content.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Cleanup proceeds with best canonical digest/OOB audit as pinned; no serialization hold.

recipes.counterexample: Group erasure emitted while receipt/snapshot/Event/inline/index/raw-capture content remains.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: No further holder visibility before cleanup; output withholding alone is insufficient.

recipes.counterexample: Live erasure commits without changed successor/tombstone or misses one containing source version.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Atomic admin refusal/rollback; no partial valid-looking group.

recipes.counterexample: Tombstone Bead has a live incident Link or inline owned set disagrees with first-class Links.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Existing deletion/graph safety retained; no raw SQL bypass.

recipes.counterexample: Receipt page is reissued/expired early, immutable execution fields changed, or erased key executes again in same epoch.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Keep exact page identities/boundaries, current erased/withheld projection and original durable disposition.

recipes.counterexample: Event ordinals renumbered, withheld cursor invalidated, or graph facts removed before every carrying Link version erased.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Stable authority ordinal/cursor and exact graph-fact predicate.

recipes.counterexample: Never-observed view receives subject identity or unrelated checkpoint expiry; simple erasure rotates epoch.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Identifier-free advance/unaffected tokens and same epoch.

recipes.counterexample: Queued pre-P frame handed after fence or write(false) treated as consumer checkpoint.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Fence lagging/backpressure and require real atomic consumer apply.

recipes.counterexample: Old backup drops newer erasure ledger/allocated IDs or old epoch key replays after history restore.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Reject incomplete continuity; retain latest identity state/new namespace and ledger-first groups.

recipes.counterexample: Event-only consumer republishes old generation when ledger status unknown.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Changefeed/snapshot-backed reconciliation or discard/refusal before publication.

recipes.counterexample: Future validation raw report/log retains erased postimage after act under an evidence exception.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Apply controlled-copy duty through separately reviewed capture lifecycle; preserve unrelated old packets, do not reconstruct missing evidence.

recipes.counterexample: SQL receipt epoch edit, blank create:true or copied hot journal labelled supported logical restore/power-loss proof.
recipes.requiredCounterObservation: Keep actual evidence/support domains distinct and missing proof UNKNOWN.
